DIAGNOSIS READY: Adhesive Capsulitis (Frozen Shoulder)

The clinical picture of a 55-year-old female with a 2-month history of insidious onset, global restriction of motion (difficulty brushing hair), and pain disrupting sleep is highly characteristic of adhesive capsulitis. Her type 2 diabetes is a significant risk factor for this condition. Given the limited number of questions remaining, I will proceed with this diagnosis based on the classic presentation of stiffness and pain.
